parts.text: Trolley A and trolley B are on a horizontal, frictionless bench. Trolley A moves to the right with a constant velocity u = 0.44 m / s. Trolley B is stationary. Fig. 2.1 shows trolley A before it collides with trolley B. Fig. 2.1 (not drawn to scale)

ms.label: 2(a)
ms.text:
(statement momentum is) zero / 0 AND
(explanation) momentum is mass × velocity OR the velocity (of B) is zero

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) After the collision, the two trolleys are joined together and travel with a constant velocity v = 0.18 m / s to the right. The mass of trolley A is 0.75 kg. Calculate the mass of trolley B. mass of trolley B = ......................................................... [3]

ms.label: 2(b)
ms.text:
1.1 kg
Conservation of momentum OR momentum after (collision) = momentum before (collision)
OR {0.75 × 0.44} = {0.75 + m} × 0.18
momentum before collision = 0.75 × 0.44 (+ m × 0 = 0.33) OR momentum after collision = (0.75 + m) × 0.18
